titre: Jokkoowo enɗam wonah jokkoowo enɗam oon jokkuɗo enɗam makko, jokkoowo enɗam woni mbo si enɗam mum taƴaama o jokko ɗam
hadith: Ittaama e Abdullaahi Ibnu Amru yo Alla weleɓe wonde Annabi yo jam e kisal won e makko maaki: Jokkoowo enɗam wonah jokkoowo enɗam oon jokkuɗo enɗam makko, jokkoowo enɗam woni mbo si enɗam mum taƴaama o jokko ɗam"
explication: Annabi yo jam e kisal won e makko ina habra: Neɗɗo timmuɗo ka jokkugol enɗam e moƴƴude e koreeji wonah moƴƴoowo e moƴƴuɗo e makko, kono woni jokkoowo enɗam woni mbo si a taƴii enɗam makko o jokko ɗam, hay siɓe mbonii e makko; kaŋko kam o yoɓratɓe moƴƴere.
benefices: Jokkere enɗam teskaande ka sariya konde njokkota enɗam oon taƴiiɗo mo, njaafaɗa tooñɗo mo, okkaa kaɗɗo mo, kono jokkude enɗam wonah yoɓrude jokkere enɗam jokkere enɗam.
Jokkere enɗam wonirta ko yottinde moƴƴere foti ko jawdi wollo ñaaganaade wollo yamirde ko moƴƴi e haɗde ko boni e ko nanndi heen, e duñde bone fotde ko kattanɗa.
ar: عن عبد الله بن عمرو رضي الله عنهما عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم قال: «لَيْسَ الْوَاصِلُ بِالْمُكَافِئِ، وَلَكِنِ الْوَاصِلُ الَّذِي إِذَا قُطِعَتْ رَحِمُهُ وَصَلَهَا».
